description: This PHP source file handles WAN configuration settings in a network gateway, including IP mode selection, static IP configuration, DNS settings, NAT options, and management of additional public subnets. It combines server-side PHP code for data processing with embedded JavaScript for client-side interaction.

methods.name: onsave
methods.description: Handles the submission of WAN configuration form, validates input, and triggers save operation including optional device reboot.

methods.name: saveWAN
methods.description: Sends WAN configuration data to server-side script via AJAX and handles response, including device restart if needed.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Records reset/reboot instruction for the device using AJAX.

methods.name: setWanDHCP
methods.description: Sends DHCP release or renew command to the backend via AJAX.

methods.name: onchangeWanMode
methods.description: Updates the form UI based on selected WAN IP method (DHCP or Static).

methods.name: onchangeManualDns
methods.description: Enables or disables manual DNS input fields and pre-fills values if specified.

methods.name: onenableSubnet
methods.description: Enables or disables additional subnet entries via AJAX, with UI updates.

methods.name: ondeleteSubnet
methods.description: Deletes a subnet entry via AJAX, with confirmation and UI refresh.

methods.name: onclickNatDisable
methods.description: Toggles the NAT DHCP checkbox based on NAT disable status.

methods.name: isWanGWInValidRange
methods.description: Validates whether the gateway IP is within a specified subnet range.
